title: Review findings (review-findings/v1)
description: The machine-readable half of a REVIEW phase result: artifacts["findings.json"]. The verdict lives here, not in the phase status, which stays runner-generic (success / failure / blocked).

file.description: The path the finding cites, as written by the reviewer; null when the finding names no file.

line.description: The line the finding cites; null when the finding names no line.

rule.description: The reviewer's own category for the finding (bug, security, issue, minor, finding).

description.description: The finding text, verbatim from the review.
